// GENERATED FILE. Source of truth: iot_cybersecurity_course/MODULE-MANIFEST.json + 30 modules/*.md
// Regenerate with: python scripts/generate_iot_cybersecurity_course.py
// 35 mins = allocated study time per lesson, NOT a confirmed YouTube runtime.
import type { Course, CourseModule, Lesson, PracticalLab, CapstoneAssessment } from '../types/course';

type VideoSource = {title: string; url: string; videoId: string; creator: string};
type LessonSource = {title: string; activity: string; practice: string; check: string};
type ModuleSource = {title: string; phase: string; hours: number; aim: string; prereq: string; task: string; output: string; steps: string[]; reading: {title:string;url:string}[]; videos: VideoSource[]; lessons: LessonSource[]};

const moduleSources: ModuleSource[] = SOURCE_DATA_GOES_HERE;

const safeCriteria = [
  'Scoped offline or explicitly authorized IoT lab only',
  'Three traceable observations; facts distinguished from hypotheses',
  'Preventive, detective and response controls justified',
  'No secrets, credentials, private keys or personally identifying data in submitted evidence',
];

function makeModule(m: ModuleSource, index: number): CourseModule {
  const n = index + 1;
  const moduleNumber = String(n).padStart(2, '0');
  const moduleTitle = `Module ${moduleNumber}: ${m.title}`;
  const difficulty = n <= 6 ? 'beginner' : n <= 17 ? 'intermediate' : 'advanced';
  const moduleLab: PracticalLab = {
    id: `iot-cybersecurity-m${moduleNumber}-lab`,
    title: `${moduleTitle} — Practical Lab`,
    objective: m.task,
    toolsRequired: ['Authorized isolated training environment or supplied static evidence', 'Notes and screenshot tool', 'SHA-256 tool when applicable'],
    // The platform currently requires pcapSource even for non-PCAP labs. The linked
    // reference is a safe educational resource; no capture download is implied.
    pcapSource: {
      fileName: 'No PCAP required; use provided lab evidence where applicable',
      fileUrl: 'https://owasp.org/owasp-istg/01_introduction/index.html',
      repositoryUrl: 'https://github.com/OWASP/IoTGoat',
    },
    difficulty,
    estimatedMinutes: Math.max(40, Math.round(m.hours * 20)),
    instructions: [m.task, ...m.steps, `Deliverable: ${m.output}`],
    tasks: m.steps.map((description, i) => ({ id: `iot-m${moduleNumber}-task-${i+1}`, description })),
    evidenceWorksheet: [
      { field: 'scope', prompt: 'Describe test ownership, scope and isolation conditions', expectedEvidenceType: 'Authorized scope statement' },
      { field: 'observations', prompt: 'Provide E1, E2, E3 with confidence and limitations', expectedEvidenceType: 'Sanitized lab artifacts' },
      { field: 'mitigations', prompt: 'Prioritize fixes and propose detection logic', expectedEvidenceType: 'Remediation and SOC handoff notes' },
      { field: 'deliverable', prompt: m.output, expectedEvidenceType: 'Report or annotated artifact' },
    ],
    questions: [], // No quizzes anywhere in this course.
    completionCriteria: safeCriteria,
  };
  const lessons: Lesson[] = m.lessons.map((entry, i) => {
    const ll=String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    const video = m.videos[i % m.videos.length];
    const summary = `${entry.activity} Practice: ${entry.practice} Completion: ${entry.check}`;
    return {
      id: `iot-cybersecurity-m${moduleNumber}-l${ll}`,
      slug: `m${moduleNumber}-l${ll}-` + entry.title.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-|-$/g, '').slice(0, 75),
      title: `Module ${moduleNumber} - Lesson ${i+1}: ${entry.title}`,
      description: summary,
      youtubeVideoId: video.videoId,
      videoAttribution: { creator: video.creator, platform: 'youtube' },
      // This is a learning-session allowance, not measured playback time.
      durationMinutes: 35,
      order: i + 1,
      moduleTitle,
      objectives: [entry.title, entry.activity, entry.practice, entry.check],
      tags: ['iot', 'cybersecurity', `module-${moduleNumber}`, m.phase.toLowerCase()],
      skillsTaught: [entry.title, m.title, 'IoT evidence handling and security reporting'],
      richContent: {
        introduction: `Study ${entry.title} in the context of ${m.title}. The linked ${video.creator} video (${video.title}) is a curated module-level source; direct coverage of every lesson segment and playback have not been independently verified.`,
        prerequisites: [m.prereq, 'Explicitly authorized or offline lab with synthetic evidence'],
        theorySections: [{ title: `IoT security principles: ${entry.title}`, content: `${m.aim}\n\n${entry.activity}`, keyPoints: [entry.title, entry.practice, entry.check] }],
        stepByStepProcedures: [
          {step: 1, title: 'Watch the curated IoT source', instruction: `Watch ${video.title} by ${video.creator}: ${video.url}. Note where this video is only supporting background.`, expectedOutcome: 'Concise original notes with attribution and coverage gaps' },
          {step: 2, title: 'Explain the IoT security concern', instruction: entry.activity, expectedOutcome: 'Describe the threat, relevant asset boundary and defensive control' },
          {step: 3, title: 'Complete scoped practice', instruction: entry.practice, expectedOutcome: 'Labeled sanitized evidence or a fictional design analysis' },
          {step: 4, title: 'Validate and report', instruction: `${entry.check} Cross-reference your evidence with the module lab: ${m.task}`, expectedOutcome: 'Fact, limitation, mitigation, false-positive consideration and response idea' },
        ],
        expectedObservations: ['Scoped observations supported by labeled evidence', 'Hypotheses separated from verified facts', 'Preventive, detective and response measures identified'],
        commonMistakes: ['Treating the shared video as a complete lesson-specific tutorial', 'Testing unowned IoT systems or transmitting against nearby radios', 'Confusing planned study minutes with video runtime', 'Revealing secrets in public reports'],
        securityRelevance: `IoT cybersecurity and SOC/DFIR context: ${entry.title}. Module: ${m.title}.`,
        practicalExercise: { title: m.task, objective: `Demonstrate ${entry.title} in a safe training context`, instructions: [entry.practice, `Lab output: ${m.output}`] },
        summary: entry.check,
        furtherReading: m.reading,
      },
    };
  });
  return {
    id: `iot-cybersecurity-m${moduleNumber}`,
    title: moduleTitle,
    description: `${m.phase} phase • ${m.hours} hours of total guided effort • Prerequisite: ${m.prereq}. ${m.aim}`,
    order: n,
    lessons,
    practicalLab: moduleLab,
    ...(n === 30 ? { capstoneAssessment: iotCapstone } : {}),
  };
}

const rubricEntries = [
  ['Authorization and scope', 10],
  ['IoT architecture and attack-surface model', 15],
  ['Firmware and configuration evidence', 20],
  ['Network telemetry and threat investigation', 15],
  ['SOC detection and triage plan', 15],
  ['Prioritized remediation and safe retest', 15],
  ['Evidence quality, communication and limitations', 10],
] as const;

const iotCapstone: CapstoneAssessment = {
  id: 'iot-capstone-soc-handoff',
  title: 'IoT Defensive Assessment & SOC Handoff',
  scenario: 'Assess only OWASP IoTGoat, synthetic IoT telemetry or an explicitly authorized isolated lab. Trace three findings from evidence through risk, mitigation and SOC detection.',
  pcapSource: { fileName: 'Optional authorized IoTGoat or synthetic PCAP', fileUrl: 'https://github.com/OWASP/IoTGoat' },
  totalMarks: 100,
  passingScore: 75,
  rubric: rubricEntries.map(([category,marks])=> ({ category, marks, criteria: ['Evidence is reproducible and properly scoped', 'Findings distinguish verified observations, assumptions and limitations'] })),
  submissionSections: rubricEntries.map(([title,maxMarks],i)=> ({ id: `iot-capstone-${i+1}`, title, prompt: `Submit ${title.toLowerCase()} with safe evidence, results and remediation guidance.`, maxMarks })),
};
